components.name: MicroPython
components.description:
Integration PRs are MicroPython-derived patches sharing the MicroPython MIT licence; the generator injects the full PR list from mbm.toml automatically.
pr/lib-pyusb-windows: lib/micropython-lib: Update pyusb with Windows support.
pr/mkrules-exe-fix: py/mkrules.mk: Allow PROG to be set on the command line for .exe targets.
pr/mkrules-frozen-str: py/mkrules.mk: Make MICROPY_MODULE_FROZEN_STR conditional on compiler.
pr/gc-add-heap: py/modgc: Add gc.add_heap() function for runtime heap expansion.
pr/ports-windows-ffi: ports/windows: Add FFI module support with libffi.
pr/unix-windows-romfs: ports/unix,windows: Add embedded romfs support with auto-mount.
pr/ports-windows-variant-overrides: ports/windows: Allow variant override of common config defines.

components.name: libffi
components.description: Statically linked into all runtime variants to support ctypes / ffi module.
